title.pt: Telhado: da telha plana ao telhado que funciona
title.en: Roof: from flat tiles to a working roof

text.pt: manter a chuva de projeto fora do ambiente
text.en: keep the design rain out of the room
no condensation dripping into the room

text.pt: teto sem desconforto radiante num dia de sol
text.en: no radiant discomfort from the ceiling on a sunny day

description.pt: telhas cerâmicas assentadas planas sobre a estrutura, sem forro
description.en: clay tiles laid flat on the structure, no ceiling

sources.rain_intensity: 150 mm/h: intensity ABNT NBR 10844:1989 allows for small roofs without local rainfall data (premise; use the local 5-year intensity)
sources.ceiling_R: premise: 12.5 mm gypsum board, lambda 0.25 W/(m K)
sources.attic_vent: premise: ~10 air changes per hour of a 1.1 m-high attic
sources.design_margin: premise: covers the spread of the lap gap, wind and rain premises

mechanism.pt: A água sobe pela fresta de 1 mm da sobreposição por capilaridade até 14 mm, o vento empurra mais 6.15 mm e sem inclinação nada tira a água do telhado: a chuva de projeto empoça 25 mm: a carga total (14 + 6.15 + 25 = 45.1 mm) é maior que os 0 mm que a sobreposição de 75 mm levanta a 0°. A água passa por cima da sobreposição e pinga dentro.
mechanism.en: Water climbs the 1 mm gap of the lap by capillarity up to 14 mm, the wind pushes it 6.15 mm further and with no slope nothing drives the water off: the design storm ponds 25 mm: the total head (14 + 6.15 + 25 = 45.1 mm) exceeds the 0 mm the 75 mm lap rises at 0°. Water gets over the lap and drips inside.

verifications.method: hydraulic barrier of a lapped joint: capillary rise between plates + wind head + Nusselt film / ponding vs lap rise

h_capillary: capillary rise in the lap gap
h_film: ponded depth of the design storm
runoff_per_width: run-off per unit width at the eaves

assumptions.pt: fresta da sobreposição como duas placas paralelas, molhamento pelo ângulo de contato dado
assumptions.en: lap gap modelled as two parallel plates wetted at the given contact angle

assumptions.pt: pressão do vento integral através da cobertura (Cp dado)
assumptions.en: full wind pressure across the covering (given Cp)

assumptions.pt: lâmina somada à carga sobre a junta (conservador)
assumptions.en: film depth added to the head on the joint (conservative)

sources: Garden (1963), 'Rain penetration and its control', NRC Canada, Canadian Building Digest CBD-40
de Gennes, Brochard-Wyart & Quere (2004), Capillarity and Wetting Phenomena, ch. 1 (rise between plates)
Bird, Stewart & Lightfoot, Transport Phenomena, 2nd ed., sec. 2.2 (laminar falling film)
CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics (properties of water at 20 °C)

validity.name: gap much smaller than capillary length (plates model)
validity.note: capillary length of water sqrt(sigma/(rho g)) = 2.7 mm

demand_label.pt: ponto de orvalho do ar interno
demand_label.en: dew point of the room air

capacity_label.pt: temperatura da superfície voltada ao ambiente
capacity_label.en: temperature of the surface facing the room

mechanism.pt: À noite de céu limpo a telha irradia para o céu a -1.74 °C e esfria até 14.2 °C; a face inferior da telha, em contato com o ar do ambiente, fica a 14.9 °C, abaixo do ponto de orvalho do ar interno (16.4 °C a 21 °C e 75 %): o vapor condensa e pinga no ambiente.
mechanism.en: On a clear night the tile radiates to the sky at -1.74 °C and cools to 14.2 °C; the tile underside, in contact with the room air, sits at 14.9 °C, below the dew point of the room air (16.4 °C at 21 °C and 75 %): vapour condenses and drips into the room.

verifications.method: steady roof heat-balance network (clear night) + Magnus dew point

q_room: W/m^2
heat flux into the room (negative: out of the room)
q_sky: W/m^2
net long-wave loss to the sky
t_dew_room: dew point of the room air

assumptions.pt: regime permanente, uma dimensão, por m² de telhado
assumptions.en: steady state, one-dimensional, per m^2 of roof

assumptions.pt: céu limpo (temperatura de céu de Swinbank)
assumptions.en: clear sky (Swinbank sky temperature)

assumptions.pt: ático ventilado com a vazão dada; placas paralelas cinzas entre telha e forro
assumptions.en: attic ventilated at the given rate; tile and ceiling as parallel grey plates

sources: Swinbank (1963), 'Long-wave radiation from clear skies', Q. J. R. Meteorol. Soc. 89, 339-348
Watmuff, Charters & Proctor (1977), wind heat-transfer coefficient h = 2.8 + 3.0 V, as given in Duffie & Beckman, Solar Engineering of Thermal Processes, sec. 3.15
ISO 6946:2017, Building components and building elements - Thermal resistance, Table 7 and Annex C
Alduchov & Eskridge (1996), 'Improved Magnus form approximation of saturation vapor pressure', J. Appl. Meteor. 35, 601-609 (a = 17.625, b = 243.04 °C)
Incropera et al., eq. 13.24 (radiation between large parallel grey plates)

self_checks.source: steady network: sun = sky + wind + ventilation + room

mechanism.pt: O sol de 900 W/m² aquece a telha até 54.7 °C; a telha sobre as pessoas fica a 52.6 °C, 25.6 K acima do ar do ambiente (27 °C), mais que os 5 K de assimetria radiante aceitáveis para teto quente: irradia 178 W/m² para dentro e incomoda.
mechanism.en: The 900 W/m^2 sun heats the tile to 54.7 °C; the tile above the occupants sits at 52.6 °C, 25.6 K above the room air (27 °C), more than the 5 K of radiant asymmetry acceptable for a warm ceiling: it pours 178 W/m^2 into the room.

verifications.method: steady roof heat-balance network (clear day, sun on the roof)

q_room: W/m^2
heat flux into the room (negative: out of the room)
q_sky: W/m^2
net long-wave loss to the sky

assumptions.en: asymmetry = ceiling surface - air temperature (large ceiling over the occupant, floor at air temperature)

title.pt: inclinar o telhado até a inclinação mínima do material
title.en: pitch the roof to the material's minimum slope

cost.note: relative index per m2 of covering (premise)

effect.pt: a gravidade passa a tirar a água (lâmina fina em vez de poça) e a sobreposição ganha altura (L·sen α) contra a capilaridade e o vento
effect.en: gravity now drains the water (thin film instead of a pond) and the lap gains height (L sin(alpha)) against capillarity and wind

title.en: lengthen the lap of the pieces

reason.pt: sem inclinação nenhuma sobreposição levanta a água (L·sen 0 = 0)
reason.en: with no slope no lap lifts the water (L sin 0 = 0)

effect.pt: a sobreposição sobe mais na mesma inclinação
effect.en: the lap rises higher at the same pitch

why.pt: resolve a falha sem quebrar nenhum requisito que passava
why.en: fixes the failure without breaking any requirement that passed

title.en: radiant heat gain from the roof

mechanism.pt: O sol de 900 W/m² aquece a telha até 59.1 °C; o forro sobre as pessoas fica a 39 °C, 12 K acima do ar do ambiente (27 °C), mais que os 5 K de assimetria radiante aceitáveis para teto quente: irradia 78.7 W/m² para dentro e incomoda.
mechanism.en: The 900 W/m^2 sun heats the tile to 59.1 °C; the ceiling above the occupants sits at 39 °C, 12 K above the room air (27 °C), more than the 5 K of radiant asymmetry acceptable for a warm ceiling: it pours 78.7 W/m^2 into the room.

finding.proof: ceiling radiant asymmetry = 12.0 K > comfort limit (warm ceiling) = 5 K

effect.pt: o ar do ambiente deixa de tocar a telha fria (ou quente): entre os dois fica um ático ventilado e o forro, que recebe a radiação da telha e a devolve ao ambiente bem mais perto da temperatura do ar
effect.en: room air no longer touches the cold (or hot) tile: a ventilated attic and the ceiling sit in between, and the ceiling, fed by the tile's radiation, faces the room much closer to the air temperature

title.en: radiant barrier (low-emissivity foil under the tiles)

effect.pt: a face inferior da telha passa a ter emissividade ~0,05: a troca radiante telha-forro, a parcela dominante, cai uma ordem de grandeza
effect.en: the tile underside gets an emissivity of ~0.05: tile-to-ceiling radiation, the dominant path, drops by an order of magnitude

effect.pt: a resistência térmica do forro aumenta: a face inferior do forro acompanha o ar do ambiente
effect.en: the ceiling's thermal resistance rises: its underside follows the room air

why.pt: resolve a falha sem quebrar nenhum requisito que passava; entre 2 opções que resolvem, é a de menor custo (0.4, 3 verificações passando; contra ceiling_insulation: 3 passando, custo 0.4)
why.en: fixes the failure without breaking any requirement that passed; of 2 options that fix it, it is the cheapest (0.4, 3 checks passing; vs ceiling_insulation: 3 passing, cost 0.4)

description.pt: telhas cerâmicas assentadas planas sobre a estrutura, sem forro
description.en: clay tiles laid flat on the structure, no ceiling

sources.rain_intensity: 150 mm/h: intensity ABNT NBR 10844:1989 allows for small roofs without local rainfall data (premise; use the local 5-year intensity)
sources.design_margin: premise: covers the spread of the lap gap, wind and rain premises

mechanism.pt: A sobreposição levanta 28.1 mm, acima da carga de capilaridade + vento + lâmina (14 + 6.15 + 0.555 = 20.7 mm): a água escorre antes de vencer a sobreposição.
mechanism.en: The lap rises 28.1 mm, above the capillary + wind + film head (14 + 6.15 + 0.555 = 20.7 mm): the water runs off before it gets over the lap.
